senses.gloss: अ-पृक्त mfn. unmixed, uncombined (said of a word [as आ and उ, Prāt.] or an affix [Pāṇ.] consisting of a single letter, i.e. of one not combined with another).
अ॑-पृणत् mfn. ‘not filling, not propitiating by gifts’, stingy, RV.
अ-पृथक् ind. not separately, with, together with, collectively.
अ-पृथक्—त्विन् mfn. not asserting a separate existence, MBh.
अ-पृथक्—श्रुति mfn. not audible separately, RPrāt.
अ-पृ—˚थग्—जित mfn. not conquered singly, Mn. vii, 97
अपृथग्-धर्मशील mfn. of the same religion.
अ-पृ—˚थग्-धर्मिन् mfn. having no separate qualities, MaitrUp.
अ-पृ—˚थग्-विवेक्य mfn. not to be distinguished, ib.
अ-पृष्ट mfn. unasked, Gaut. &c.
आ-पृष्ट mfn. welcomed, saluted, MBh.
asked for, L.
1. आ-√ 1. पृ P. (aor. Subj. 2. du. -पर्षथस्, RV. x, 143, 4) to give aid, protect.
2. आ-√ 2. पृ P. (-पृणोति) to employ one's self, to be occupied, BhP.
आ-पृत mfn. occupied, engaged, BhP.
आ-पृ॑क् ind. in a mixed manner, in contact with, RV. x, 89, 14.
आ-पृच्छा See under आ-√ प्रछ्.
आ-पृच्छा f. conversation, speaking to or with
address
bidding farewell, saluting on receiving a visitor, asking, inquiring, L.
1. आ-पृ॑च्छ्य mfn. (Pāṇ. iii, 1, 123) to be inquired for
to be respected, RV. i, 60, 2
to be praised, laudable, commendable, RV.
2. आ-पृच्छ्य ind.p. having saluted or asked or inquired.
